_comment: Text corrections applied to extracted VPK strings. Each entry is a regex 'find' applied via re.sub against every string field (description, lore, notes, names) in items_full.json, units_full.json, synergies.json, relics.json, abilities.json. The 'where' field is optional: if present, the correction only applies to matching entity types. The 'note' field is human-readable context, ignored at runtime.

corrections.note: Blink Dagger and Overwhelming Blink misspell 'farthest' as 'farest'.
